status: Measurements and successful rechecks complete; intermittent startup failures and real live-stream acceptance remain unresolved

measurement_conditions.completion_rule: curl/process exit 0, HTTP 200, exact object bytes and verified source; parallel round goodput requires every stream complete
measurement_conditions.goodput_rule: complete object bits divided by actual round wall time including startup and response; single medians exclude incomplete rounds but retain failures in denominator
measurement_conditions.https_load_admission_rule: request start in associated transfer round [start, end-5s]; retain all admitted outcomes; empty window is not a passing result

initial_16MiB_aborted.followup_object_checks: same AU source and pinned CF target: 1 MiB, decimal 10 MB and 32 MiB exact HTTP 200; 16 MiB recheck HTTP 403

limitations: Different endpoint, size and time series are not pooled into one throughput or A/B gain.
AU groups share the existing exit and bandwidth; sequential speeds are not additive.
A separate exit probe verifies that request only; it does not identify every OVH download proxy socket.
Some CF transfers have no strict load-probe admission samples; the US upload recheck has only two.
Successful requests still showed second-scale warm and cold/reconnect tails.
US startup timeouts and CF refusals/quotas remain unlocalized; later complete transfers do not erase failures.
No new production parameter change or configuration A/B was made to attribute a speed gain.
Real phone streaming, simultaneous groups, peak hours and maximum capacity remain unaccepted.
Raw configurations, addresses, SSIDs, MACs, credentials and unredacted logs remain private.
